newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index leaps on the back of IBM, Philip Morris.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index leaps on the back of IBM, Philip Morris.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rose sharply Monday as big gains in the shares of International Business Machines Corp. and Philip Morris Cos. accounted for nearly half of the 30-stock index's rise.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended 76.58 points higher, or 1.10 percent, at 7,008.20, which was short of last Tuesday's record close of 7,067.46.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 14-10 on active volume of 462 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
